profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI/LLM & Agentic Systems | MCP, RAG, AI Agents | Python, TypeScript, React | Distributed Systems & Cloud Infrastructure
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable distributed systems, developer platforms, and full-stack applications. Specialized in AI/LLM and agentic systems, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, multi-agent workflows, RAG, and AI-powered developer tooling. Proven track record building production systems at Datadog, Amazon, and American Express, including platforms generating $130M+ in annualized revenue and developer tools adopted by 1,000+ engineers. Experienced in technical leadership, system architecture, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and building secure, multi-tenant AI integrations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  Architected and implemented an Integration Gateway enabling AI agents to securely discover and execute tools across multi-tenant customer Kubernetes environments.
-  Designed Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints, tool-mapping engines, multi-cluster routing, and secure-tunnel integrations to support scalable agentic AI workflows.
-  Built a custom GitLab MCP Server enabling AI agents to search codebases, analyze Merge Requests, generate positioned review comments, and autonomously create and publish MRs.
-  Implemented code search capabilities across entire codebase, allowing agents to discover and analyze code patterns instantly.
-  Built automated Merge Request (MR) creation and publishing workflow, enabling agents to draft, format, and submit code changes autonomously.
-  Authored documentation to share with team, 10x-ing developer productivity by enabling AI-assisted development workflows.
-  Enhanced an Atlassian MCP Server with local file synchronization, enabling docs-as-code workflows while reducing tool execution time and LLM token overhead by approximately 10x.
-  Contributed to AI-powered Root Cause Analysis (RCA) workflows integrating specialized agents for logs, APM, and entity mapping.
-  Designed human-in-the-loop AI workflows for incident management, including JIRA ticket creation, structured AI-to-tool input mapping, and extensible ticketing-platform integrations.
-  Evaluated and prototyped agentic AI frameworks including CrewAI and LlamaIndex; mentored engineers on AI tooling, MCP patterns, and agentic system architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  Developed interactive troubleshooting and observability experiences, including real-time WebSocket-based communication for live system feedback.
-  Built DAG/tree visualization components with dynamic node and edge positioning to visualize complex troubleshooting and workflow states.
-  Designed and implemented backend and frontend components for production observability workflows in distributed environments.
-  Developed Python tooling and Pydantic-based data models for structured API integrations and reliable data validation.
-  Contributed enhancements to AI-powered Root Cause Analysis (RCA) workflows integrating specialized agents for logs, APM, and entity mapping.
-  Implemented frontend code for interactive troubleshooting interfaces with real-time WebSocket communication for AI agent feedback.
-  Developed tree-view visualization components with DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) dynamic node and edge positioning layout, applying graph theory algorithms for optimal workflow state visualization.
-  Designed reusable abstractions and integration patterns supporting external enterprise systems and internal platform services.
-  Contributed to technical design, task estimation, acceptance criteria, roadmap planning, and cross-team engineering initiatives.
Technologies: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, MCP, Pydantic, WebSockets, GitLab, JIRA, Confluence, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, APM, Distributed Systems, Agentic AI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  Led full-stack development for Amazon Custom and Amazon Business platforms serving millions of daily consumer and seller users.
-  Designed and implemented customization features across Search Results and Detail Pages, driving $130M+ in combined annualized revenue.
-  Owned end-to-end system design spanning APIs, DynamoDB schemas, AQL queries, and frontend UX under strict latency SLAs (<50ms).
-  Authored and drove complex design documents through multiple architectural review cycles in high-ambiguity, multi-team environments.
-  Built and launched internal VS Code extension suite for Amazon Query Language (AQL), adopted by 1,000+ engineers.
-  Enabled IDE-based query execution, navigation, testing, and coverage reporting, saving ~156,000 engineering hours annually.
-  Implemented accessibility (keyboard navigation, screen readers) and internationalization across global marketplaces.
-  Developed reusable frontend components and UX patterns with pixel-perfect fidelity to design specifications.
-  Collaborated cross-functionally with Search, Detail Page, API, and Infrastructure teams to unblock cross-org dependencies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-  Built React and TypeScript-based frontend systems integrated with C# backend services for enterprise financial platforms.
-  Developed core UI frameworks for dynamic table, form, filter, and entity-driven component generation.
-  Designed APIs and data models enabling automatic data subscription and real-time UI updates.
-  Served as local UX authority, defining frontend best practices and guiding design consistency across teams.
-  Led whiteboard prototyping sessions to validate product direction and accelerate stakeholder alignment.
-  Delivered cross-system integrations with internal AmEx platforms supporting high-availability production workloads.
